jobs.description:

This driving position requires a valid license, a strong safety mindset, and the ability to work a night schedule. Allied Universal offers training, growth, and comprehensive benefits.

jobs.description:
Allied Universal is seeking a Security Officer Access Authorization in Fort Worth, TX. This role focuses on controlling entry points, verifying credentials, and maintaining a safe, welcoming environment for employees, visitors, and deliveries at a logistics and distribution site.

You will monitor access points, respond to incidents, and perform regular patrols while delivering exceptional service in a dynamic security role. Salary is paid hourly with a full-time schedule.
